exposure: dinoprostone for cervical ripening and labor induction
cohort: 104 women with a Bishop score ≤ 5, divided into two groups: those with term isolated oligohydramnios (n=40) and those with normal amniotic fluid volume (n=64)
finding: Dinoprostone for labor induction in women with term oligohydramnios and a Bishop score ≤ 5 did not significantly affect the time from induction to delivery but was associated with an increased CS rate.
mod_finding: Induction of labor with dinoprostone in term pregnancies with isolated oligohydramnios is associated with increased rate of CS.
